chunks: Al-Saffar from Muhammad ibn 'Isa from Yunus from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

I asked him about the minimum act that, if a man performs with a woman who is not permissible to his father or his son, [makes her forbidden]. He said: The boundary in that is sexual intercourse, whether apparent or hidden, that resembles the touching of the two private parts.

key_terms.بَاطِنَةً: Hidden or internal (referring to deep/internal intercourse)
key_terms.ظَاهَرَةً: Apparent or open (referring to visible intercourse)

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum sexual act that makes a woman permanently forbidden to her father and son in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Ishtibār, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the threshold of consummation (khalāʿ) that establishes permanent prohibition (ḥurmah) between a father and son regarding the same woman. By defining the boundary as any act resembling the touching of the private parts, whether apparent or hidden, the Imam provides a precise juristic criterion for determining when the relationship becomes irrevocably forbidden, a key concept in Shia fiqh of marriage.
